items.title: KPAC Leela’s long journey from the stage to a second innings on screen
items.summary: In the undulating flow of words that come from KPAC Leela, it seems possible to time travel for a little while, from the chaotic 2020s to the sweet lull of the 1950s. Age has withered the disappointments of her youth, when she wanted to be dancer but ended up in a theatre group, when she had to leave behind the stage she loved for the family she created, when she had to let go of opportunities without even knowing they had come to her. Leela, in this late stage of her life, is unexpectedly in the limelight again, as an actor on the screen, rediscovered for her distinct depictions in Malayalam cinema. Roudram 2018 , Pookkaalam , Granny, and Bhoothayanam , among several other films of the last decade, have given Leela a warm welcome back to the world of acting she’d once left behind. That this is a veteran who had once received appreciation from India’s first Prime Minister Jawaharlal Nehru makes her comeback especially prized. Serendipity brought her before the camera after a long gap when director Jayaraj cast her for his Roudram 2018 , a drama set in the real-life floods of that year.
